title: introduce-kms-usage-evaluator-policy-simulator-and-audit-reconciler
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We need a low-risk way to change tenant RBAC/KMS mappings and residency constraints without surprising production behavior. This PR delivers three coordinated components: (1) kms-usage-evaluator: daily/adhoc job that attributes KMS calls to tenants, operators, and routes; (2) policy-simulator: a local/CI tool to simulate proposed RBAC v2 policy edits against historical auth events to estimate denial rates and KMS call deltas; (3) audit-reconciler: a reconciler to backfill and canonicalize audit entries when policy migrations cause reattachment of KMS claims. The single-string description below covers design, usage, tests, and rollout checklist.
Design summary: kms-usage-evaluator computes tenant-level KMS metrics (calls, key-ids used, average latency, region affinity) and writes a time-bucketed report to /metrics/kms_tenant_usage/{tenant}/{yyyy-mm-dd}. policy-simulator consumes a policy diff (yaml) and a historical auth event sample (ndjson) and produces a scored report: predicted_denials, predicted_kms_delta_percent, affected_routes, confidence_score. audit-reconciler consumes evaluator output + simulator plan and replays canonical audit envelopes for a configured window to ensure downstream compliance systems see consistent KMS provenance after a migration.
Usage examples:
- Run a local simulation: ./tools/policy-sim --policy-proposed example/policy-proposed.yaml --events sample/events-2025-01-*.ndjson --out report.json
- Inspect tenant KMS usage for tenant-42: ./bin/kms-eval query --tenant tenant-42 --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-01-31
- Backfill audits for tenant-42 after migration: ./bin/audit-reconcile apply --tenant tenant-42 --window 2025-01-01:2025-01-15
Key constraints & safety: reads-only by default; audit-reconciler has a dry-run mode and requires explicit allowlist for mutate mode (ENV: AUDIT_RECONCILE_ALLOWLIST). The reconciler signs generated audit envelopes with a rotated reconciliation key and emits reconciliation metrics to metrics/reconciler/{tenant}.
Checklist:
- [x] design doc linked (ENG-1976)
- [x] unit + integration tests
- [x] end-to-end dry-run against staging (ran 2025-01-24)
- [x] security review by SEC (Renee)
- [x] migration playbook added in docs/tools/policy-sim/README.md
Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main (feature flags off).
2) Run kms-usage-evaluator in observation mode for 2 weeks, compare with existing KMS telemetry.
3) Run policy-simulator for upcoming RBAC changes before scheduling enforce window.
4) Execute audit-reconciler in dry-run for target tenants, review reconciliation diff, then enable apply for small cohort.
5) Gradual ramp to 100% tenants; monitor reconciler.errors and kms.tenants.delta metrics.
Testing: Added unit tests for evaluator aggregation logic (edge-case: multi-key per-request), simulator fidelity tests (sample dataset with injected denies), reconciler idempotency tests. CI: policy-scan, unit, integration, e2e-staging run; addressed flaky step in e2e by adding a retry backoff.
Migration notes: This PR includes a small migration that adds two DB tables (kms_tenant_usage and audit_reconcile_jobs). Migration adds an index on (tenant_id, date) and is reversible. Rollback plan: disable reconciler apply, delete reconciliation jobs created by the job-runner, and run compensating audit canonicalizer.
Logging and observability: new dashboards added at Observability -> Security -> KMS Usage; reconciler exposes reconciliation.duration, reconciliation.applied_count, reconciliation.dryrun_diff_count, simulator.predicted_denial_rate histograms.
Security review summary: threat model considered malicious operator spoofing KMS key IDS in events; evaluator cross-checks with signed KMS response headers and drops suspicious events, flagged to security. The reconciler signs backfilled audits with reconciliation-key and tags metadata.reconciled_by = "reconciler/v1".
Related work: builds on ENG-1452 (policy dry-run infra) and leverages the existing audit-envelope format introduced in PR pr-73199.
Migration controls: policy-simulator has a confidence threshold (default 0.75) before recommending enforcement; teams must opt into lower thresholds.
Documentation: docs/tools/policy-sim/README.md and docs/ops/audit-reconcile-playbook.md included in the change set. This description string is intentionally compact and single-block for PR metadata export.

review_discussion: Markus: Could the simulator be expensive on large event sets? Aisha: We included sampling and a streaming estimator; default sample rate is 0.1 but configurable. Renee: I reviewed the threat model; we need to make reconciler-key rotation explicit in docs. Aisha: Added rotation docs and config (docs/ops/audit-reconcile-playbook.md). Samir: Please add an integration test that verifies reconciliation is idempotent. Aisha: Added idempotency test and a second run condition in reconciler. Markus: Approving after tests green. Renee: Security approve. Merge-by: squash. Post-merge: schedule observation run for the evaluator on staging.
release_notes: Added a tenant-level KMS usage evaluator, a policy simulator to estimate RBAC/KMS impact before policy changes, and an audit reconciler to backfill canonical audit envelopes post-migration. Includes DB migrations, dashboards, and operator playbook. No breaking changes when feature flags off.
testing_plan: Unit + integration + e2e staging dry-run. Run evaluator in observation mode for two weeks, verify metrics parity, then run reconciler dry-run for pilot tenants and validate diffs with compliance before enabling apply.
rollback_plan: Disable reconciler apply, remove reconciliation jobs, and run compensating canonicalizer to restore audit view. DB migrations are reversible via the included down migration.
performance_impact: Evaluator adds a daily aggregation job (CPU + IO). Policy-simulator is offline/CI only. Reconciler apply can be rate-limited; default rate is 10 reconciles/min per worker. Expected steady-state RPS impact: negligible when feature off.
security_review: Security reviewed by Renee Alvarez; concerns addressed include signed KMS response validation, reconciler signing, allowlist for apply mode, and key rotation docs. SEC sign-off obtained 2025-01-28.
notes_for_ops: Ops: enable feature flag 'kms_eval_enabled' in staging, set AUDIT_RECONCILE_ALLOWLIST for pilot tenants, monitor metrics security.reconciler.errors and security.kms.tenant_delta. Follow playbook in docs/ops/audit-reconcile-playbook.md for apply.
